fullDescription: The default user-profile-overview view composes a GitHub-style profile header, developer sidebar, pinned public repositories, and yearly contribution activity using UserProfileOverview.

DashboardHome renders the default repository dashboard state with interactive search fields, repository filtering, star actions, a dismissible event card, and reminder toggling. It accepts a serializable state prop, defaulting to default, and provides reusable feed and repository card composition within the dashboard.

UserProfileOverview renders a developer profile with selectable navigation tabs and contribution years, pinned repository cards, profile metadata, achievement badges, and an activity heatmap. It accepts a serializable state prop that defaults to default for reuse in profile overview screens.
